landing.headline: How inclusive is your business?
landing.subheading: Take our 2-minute Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Health Check to discover how your organisation stacks up.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Answer 8 quick-fire questions to reveal your organisation's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Health Score:
steps: Answer questions about your current practices
Receive your DEI Health Score instantly
Get practical next steps tailored to your organisation

landing.keyAreasHeading: You’ll be scored based on the following 4 key areas:

keyAreas.name: Inclusive Hiring and Recruitment
keyAreas.description: How accessible, equitable, and inclusive your hiring processes are, including how well you reach and attract talent from diverse backgrounds.

keyAreas.name: Workplace Culture and Inclusion
keyAreas.description: How well your organisation fosters a sense of belonging, respect, fairness and genuine inclusion for all staff.

keyAreas.name: Policies, Systems and Practices
keyAreas.description: The systems, processes, and initiatives in place to promote and sustain diversity, equity, and inclusion in everyday business operations.

keyAreas.name: Staff Capability and Training
keyAreas.description: How confident and equipped your staff are to engage with diversity and inclusion through training, awareness and everyday practice.

about: CoAct Connect partners with employers to build stronger, more diverse teams through inclusive hiring practices. As a leading national network of not-for-profit employment service providers, we specialise in connecting you with talented individuals, including those with disabilities, to foster a more inclusive and dynamic workforce. Our expertise and local connections ensure you get the support you need to hire and retain the best people for your business.

questions.text: We actively recruit people from diverse backgrounds in our organisation.
People involved in hiring at our organisation have been trained in inclusive recruitment practices, such as inclusive interviewing and candidate adjustments.
Our staff have received diversity, equity, and inclusion training, including cultural awareness and unconscious bias training.
We are confident making reasonable adjustments or accommodations to support employees' diverse needs.
We have a clear policy that supports diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
We engage with community groups or employment services to attract candidates from diverse backgrounds.
We regularly seek feedback from staff about their experience of inclusion and belonging at work.
We promote a culture of inclusion where all employees feel valued, respected, and able to contribute fully.

low.headline: You're just getting started on your DEI journey.
low.body: Your score suggests there are significant opportunities to build a more inclusive and equitable workplace. The good news? You've taken the first step by assessing where you stand.

medium.headline: You're on the right track.
medium.body: Your business is demonstrating a commitment to DEI, and it shows in some of your practices. There are still a few areas that could be strengthened to build greater consistency, especially as your team grows or hiring needs change.

high.headline: Congratulations, you're on your way to being a Diversity Champion!
high.body: You've clearly embedded inclusive practices across your organisation. Your leadership, policies and culture reflect a genuine commitment to creating a safe and equitable workplace.

low.description: You may not be reaching diverse talent effectively. Consider reviewing your job ads for inclusive language and expanding your sourcing beyond traditional channels.
helpBullets: Connect with inclusive employment services (Workforce Australia & IEA)
Access diverse candidates, with support for onboarding and adjustments
Review and rewrite your job ads for inclusiveness

medium.description: You've started to build inclusive recruitment practices, but they may not be applied consistently or intentionally.
helpBullets: Formalise outreach partnerships with community networks
Create inclusive hiring guides or checklists
Offer role-matching support for job-ready candidates

high.description: You're actively working to remove bias from your hiring process and reach underrepresented candidates.
helpBullets: Showcase your brand as a 'Diversity Champion'
Streamline hiring from our job-ready candidate pool
Provide disability confident training for hiring managers

low.description: You may not yet have structures to listen to or support the lived experiences of diverse staff.
helpBullets: Access inclusion-focused training
Provide surveying tools to collect staff feedback
Share best practices for inclusive team communication

medium.description: You're creating a respectful workplace, but deeper inclusion efforts may be informal or inconsistent.
helpBullets: Access training to help build culture of psychological safety and belonging
Provide advice for inclusive onboarding and team norms

high.description: You've embedded belonging into your workplace culture. Well done!
helpBullets: Highlight your story as a success case study
Connect you with partners to deepen impact in the community

low.description: You may lack formal policies or processes to support inclusion.
helpBullets: Provide DEI policy templates
Guide you on legal obligations and adjustment protocols
Set up simple, scalable inclusion practices

medium.description: You have some good practices but may not have formalised them or reviewed them recently.
helpBullets: Review existing policies through a DEI lens
Create simple accessibility checklists and process guides
Advise on adjustments, accommodations and inclusive workplace standards

high.description: You have solid DEI-aligned policies and confidently apply inclusive practices.
helpBullets: Partner with you to create more inclusive supply chains
Promote your business as a 'Diversity Champion'

low.description: Training may be informal or nonexistent. DEI efforts risk being misunderstood or inconsistently applied.
helpBullets: Deliver foundational DEI training
Offer disability confidence workshops
Build DEI awareness into your team's onboarding

medium.description: You've taken steps to raise awareness, but may not have consistent training across the team.
helpBullets: Identify high-impact training areas
Deliver short sessions for busy teams
Introduce cultural awareness and inclusive leadership workshops

high.description: Your team is well-equipped and confident engaging in inclusive practices.
helpBullets: Share your success in case studies or panels
Deepen specialist training (e.g., mental health, accessibility)
Collaborate on mentoring or reverse-mentoring programs
